title.zh: 获取纳管实例分布的区域列表

descriptions.zh: 本接口获取的是当前用户存在被 SysOM 纳管机器的区域列表，如果用户在某个区域下有 ECS 实例，但是没有被 SysOM 纳管，则该区域不会出现在接口的结果里面。
descriptions.en: This operation retrieves the list of regions where the current user has instances managed by SysOM. If a user has ECS instances in a region but none of them are managed by SysOM, that region is not included in the response.
